description:
Add or replace a Code component: JavaScript a project runs. It runs on ONE event you choose (`event`): RENDER_BEFORE (default) every frame, for movement (held keys: this.keysPressed); KEY_DOWN / KEY_UP once per press / release; MOUSE_CLICK, SWIPE, MUSIC_BEAT, PHYSICS_COLLISION once per click, swipe, beat, collision. A script per event: r3_docs_read("HOWTO_CODE_EVENTS.md"). Kept at once in the live copy every open R3 tab runs (r3_editor_code: the same tool).

r3_project_load names the entityRefs; r3_docs_read("CODE_PATTERNS.md") is the API (a guessed one silently does nothing).

The code is a function body:
```js
this.update = function(data) {
  this['mesh_cube_1'].rotation.y += data.delta;
};
return {update: this.update};   // REQUIRED (also start, dispose) — nothing runs without it
```
Reach a component as `this['<entityRef>']`, infrastructure with this.getProject() / getScene() / getCamera() / getWorld() / getAudioListener() / getEntityInstance(). Anything else returned is an api other scripts call: `this['<entityRef>'].api.<name>(...)`. Code that creates things (scene objects, timers, listeners) frees them in a returned `dispose`: R3 calls it on re-save, Stop and delete.

No getComponentByRef, this.state, this.getSibling or R3 global: code using them is REFUSED.

EVENTS (by NAME; default RENDER_BEFORE): RENDER_BEFORE, RENDER_AFTER, KEY_DOWN, KEY_UP, MOUSE_DOWN, MOUSE_UP, MOUSE_MOVE, MOUSE_WHEEL, MOUSE_CLICK, TOUCH_START, TOUCH_MOVE, TOUCH_END, TOUCH_CANCEL, SWIPE, MUSIC_BEAT, MUSIC_BAR, SONG_CUE, PHYSICS_COLLISION. Their `data` (mouse: nested, -1..+1): the how-to's table.

Pass entityRef + baseVersion (r3_code_read's codeVersion) to REPLACE a script; name (or neither) to create one. Never merged: an older one is refused with the current code.

PATCH a long script: replacements [{old, new, count?}] + baseSha256 (r3_code_read's), no code; all or nothing, each old found exactly count (default 1) times; ≤ 200 replacements, 60000 chars.

baseSha256.description: With replacements only: the sha256 r3_code_read answered for the script (of its WHOLE code) at baseVersion.

baseVersion.description: REQUIRED with entityRef: the codeVersion r3_code_read answered for that script. A write on an older version is refused with the current code, never merged. Leave it out when creating.

code.description: The JavaScript. A function body that returns {start, update} — see the description. Omit it when you send replacements.

componentId.description: Or the id of the EXISTING Code component to replace (instead of entityRef).

entityRef.description: The entityRef of an EXISTING Code component to replace, as reported by r3_project_load. Cannot be combined with name.

event.description: Which event runs it, by NAME: RENDER_BEFORE, RENDER_AFTER, KEY_DOWN, KEY_UP, MOUSE_DOWN, MOUSE_UP, MOUSE_MOVE, MOUSE_WHEEL, MOUSE_CLICK, TOUCH_START, TOUCH_MOVE, TOUCH_END, TOUCH_CANCEL, SWIPE, MUSIC_BEAT, MUSIC_BAR, SONG_CUE, PHYSICS_COLLISION. Default RENDER_BEFORE on create; left unchanged on update.

name.description: Label for a NEW Code component, e.g. "Spin". Cannot be combined with entityRef.

projectId.description: The project to write into, from r3_project_create or r3_project_load.

replacements.description: Instead of code: exact replacements on the script at baseVersion, in order, all or nothing (at most 200, 60000 characters of old + new in all).

count.description: How many times old occurs, all replaced (default 1).

new.description: What replaces it (empty deletes it). Taken literally.

old.description: Exact text in the script (whitespace and line breaks count).

name: r3_code_write

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Write code that runs in an R3 project
